ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $\angle AOC = 90^\circ$, OC bisects $\angle DOB$, and $\angle DOC = 25^\circ 35'$. Find the degree measure of $\angle BOA$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $OC$ bisects $\angle DOB$ and $\angle DOC=25^\circ35'$, \\
it follows that $\angle DOC=\angle BOC=25^\circ35'$. \\
Since $\angle AOC=90^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BOA=90^\circ-25^\circ35'=64^\circ25'$. \\
Hence, the answer is $\boxed{64^\circ25'}$.
